chapter: Youth, Storyville and the bands he heard
title: Hearing a trumpeter in Storyville who encouraged him
summary: A nice trumpet player in a small Storyville group encouraged him; bands were on every corner.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: You mentioned Bart Johnson before. Do you remember anything special about him?
No, nothing special, but he was a nice trumpet player and I liked to start playing. You heard him play? Oh, yeah. Before you started playing? Yeah, before I started playing.
Did he, was he a nice fella?

Yeah, yeah, he was a really nice fella. Come on, I knew him. Yeah. What band did he play with? Well, when I met him, he was, I don't know whether he had a special band, but he was playing in Storyville down there in Red Light District. A small group? A small group of people, about four or five people, piano and stuff later. You don't remember who he played?
No. Did you meet him later again?

Oh, I saw him a few times after that, you know. But I spent half a night with him that night. And he encouraged me a whole lot, you know. I told him I liked to play a trumpet, I was trying, and he gave me some encouragement. That's wonderful. Yeah.
Where did you say this was? Remember what street?

I can't play a street, but down there ain't Storyville where they had the Red Light District. That would be between Canal and Conti. Wow. You know, one of them streets. Yeah, right in there. I know the neighborhood. Yeah.
But it was like a tonk, huh? Yeah, that's right.
At every corner they had a band. So, man.
Do you remember any other bands you had down there? Any other?

Well, quite a few bands, but I couldn't remember them right now by name, but they had quite a few. I mean, they had so much music down there at night that it sounded like one trying to outdo the other.
